goalbuddy_receipt_v1.rationale: The revised owner outcome is fully proven. The saved 44-layer Seatify example, current implementation reviews, live QA at 100% and 125–150%, strict preference tests, and fresh 384-test check cover the complete oracle. The owner supplied the required physical-key confirmation, exactly: Control-left marquee QA passed. Control start-over-artwork, Shift-add, feedback, ordinary drag, and context-menu suppression therefore have real hardware evidence. Automated and reviewed paths cover empty-canvas arbitration, exact click, cancellation, persistence corruption, accessibility, serialization, history, and gesture coexistence. No required Worker remains; T009 is a historical failed attempt fully superseded by T011 and T010 approval.

evidence.proof: examples/seatify-constellation.svg contains the saved 44-layer Seatify constellation, README links it as the complex example, and tests/complex-seatify-fixture.test.ts participates in the green full suite.

T030 records the owner's exact physical-key pass phrase: Control-left marquee QA passed. The required walkthrough began over artwork and confirmed enclosed-object selection, violet halos, one primary handle set, matching badge count, ordinary drag preservation, and no native context menu.

The T030 owner walkthrough included a physical Shift-add marquee. T024 locked Shift at pointerdown, T025/T028 implemented it, and T029 approved irreversible threshold and full-union normalization coverage.

StageGestureController behaviorally proves below-4px exact Control toggle, at-or-above-4px irreversible marquee, frozen candidate and Shift, start over artwork or empty canvas, and no object mutation. T029 independently reviewed stage-capture wiring; T030 proves the physical ControlLeft activation identity.

evidence.oracle_clause: Physical identity, right Control, and macOS context menu
evidence.proof: KeyboardEvent.code ControlLeft is the sole default arming identity; ControlRight tests and source review prove it cannot arm. The one-shot causal context-menu controller is behaviorally tested at click origins and distant drag endpoints, invalidates on later pointerdown, excludes non-canvas and non-Control events, and T030 confirms no native menu during real Control gestures.

Editor interaction tests cover visible leaf-most descendants across nested parents, DOM ordering, full additive ancestor/descendant normalization, locked-visible inclusion, hidden exclusion, contain/touch geometry, and frozen scope. T005 and T027 live evidence confirms nested complex artwork and multi-object feedback.

T027 live QA passed synchronized three-object halos, Layers rows, primary handles, and badge at 100% and 125% with collapsed sidebars. T005/T008 additionally exercised transformed nested geometry and contain/touch selection at 149–150%.

evidence.oracle_clause: Canvas, count badge, and Layers synchronization
evidence.proof: T027 observed three independent violet halos, three aria-pressed Layers rows, one stronger primary row and handle set, and a 3 objects selected badge. The same state remained synchronized with both sidebars collapsed and at 125% zoom. Source and tests cover all-selected ancestry expansion and filter clearing.

Per-object halos are separate editor overlays that never alter authored filters. T027 visibly confirmed axis-aligned line feedback and minimum halos with Enhanced outlines off; T028/T029 prove scale-aware nonzero geometry and clean serialization/history.

Every selected object receives an individual halo, while only the primary receives the blue svg.js selection box and handles. Multi-selection mutation controls remain gated; no union box, numbering, shared handle set, collective movement, cross-parent resize, or cross-parent rotation was introduced.

Behavioral controller and editor tests cover Space-primary and middle-button pan precedence, ordinary object drag, handle resize/rotation, Alt-click, double-click, configured precise selection, unmodified background drag, wheel/zoom retention, and successor-click suppression. T014 and T030 provide live ordinary drag, resize/rotation, exact selection, and physical Control coexistence evidence.

Reviewed and green tests cover keyup, Escape before focus/modal guards, blur, hidden visibility, editable/modal focus, pointercancel, lost capture, review lock, document replacement, selection restoration, click suppression, pointer release, and fresh-key requirements. T005 live QA confirmed Escape clearing without dirtying.

The compact Preferences & shortcuts dialog implements precise modifier, Left Control/M activation, contain/touch mode, logical/exact click depth, Enhanced outlines, and Restore defaults. T008 live-tested the original four values and reload; T027 live-tested activation, enhanced minimum feedback, Restore defaults, and reloaded Left Control state.

The strict global v2 record defaults to Left Control, migrates an exact v1 record only when v2 is absent, rejects malformed, partial, extra-key, and future records atomically, survives storage acquisition/write failure, and remains independent of workspace/session restoration. Current focused tests and T029 review verify the boundary.

The labelled native dialog has initial focus, forward/reverse focus containment, Escape/backdrop closure, and invoker focus return. The count badge uses role=status, aria-live=polite, and aria-atomic=true outside both sidebars; selected Layers rows expose aria-pressed. Reduced-motion behavior is covered by the approved UX suite.

evidence.oracle_clause: Clean SVG, dirty state, history, and console
evidence.proof: Selection rectangles, halos, handles, fallback markers, and editor attributes are stripped from clean and snapshot serialization. Interaction tests prove byte stability and no undo checkpoints. T027 observed Undo and Save disabled after selection-only work and no browser warnings/errors; T008 provides matching live dirty/history evidence.
The final Judge's fresh run passed TypeScript checking, all 20 test files and 384 tests, and the production Vite build.

The working tree contains the expected reversible feature, example, goal, preference, UI, editor, style, and test changes while preserving pre-existing session/layout work. Inspection found no dependency modification, exported editor state, union selection box, or generalized multi-object transform expansion.

T025 and T028 are done; T024, T026, and T029 provide contract and implementation gates; T027 and T030 provide live and physical-owner proof. No queued or active Worker remains. T009's blocked receipt records an earlier verification attempt whose sole typing blocker was resolved by T011 and explicitly accepted by T010.
The GoalBuddy state checker reports ok=true with no errors or warnings and T999 as the sole active final task.
